capabilities: Render Markdown headings and nested lists as mindmap nodes
Add, rename, delete, and drag nodes to reorganize branches
Edit section content in the native Markdown editor below the map
Copy, cut, and paste subtrees, including across notes
Preview linked notes and expand linked outlines
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.7+); tested on macOS, Windows and Linux unverified. Default interface language is Traditional Chinese and some editor labels and error messages remain in it even after switching. Documentation is duplicated in English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, with video tutorials on YouTube. Free; donations optional. Warns that edits modify Markdown files directly and undo is not a backup.
problem: Obsidian shows note structure only as an outline or graph; there is no built-in way to view and reorganize a note's headings as an editable mindmap.
summary: Mindmap plugin that renders Markdown headings as an interactive, editable node map and writes changes back to the note.
